name: Thin Python
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: python3 scripts/check.py
print('checked')

name: Package Manager
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: corepack enable
      - run: pnpm --dir docs-site validate
      - run: "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint" .github/workflows/*.yml

name: Runner
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: PYTHONPATH=speckit-pro python3 -m speckit_pro_runner < requests/check.json
      - run: echo 'status=pass' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: Python Shell
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - shell: python
        run: import runpy; runpy.run_path("scripts/check.py", run_name="__main__")
print('checked')

name: Control
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if test -f result.json; then
            python3 scripts/check.py
          fi

name: Forbidden
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: jq -e . result.json
      - run: tools/check.sh

name: Heredoc
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          print('inline')
          PY

name: Sentinel
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          result=success
          if [[ "$result" == "success" ]]; then
            exit 0
          fi

name: Untracked Input
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: python3 -m speckit_pro_runner < missing.json
